info.name: Resume RAG - Phase 9
info.description: Verification requests for structured algorithmic resume parsing.

body.raw:
{
  "rawText": "Rajesh Mohan Kumar
Test Architect & Senior Agentic Test Engineer
Testleaf Software Solutions Private Limited
B.Tech - Information Technology
13+ years of experience
Skills: Selenium WebDriver, Core Java, C#, Python, REST Assured, Postman, RAG, DeepEval, MCP (Model Context Protocol)"
}

exec: pm.test('Resume is parsed structurally', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.resume.name).to.eql('Rajesh Mohan Kumar'); pm.expect(body.resume.role).to.eql('Test Architect & Senior Agentic Test Engineer'); pm.expect(body.resume.totalExperience).to.eql(13); pm.expect(body.resume.skills).to.include.members(['Selenium', 'Python', 'RAG', 'DeepEval', 'MCP (Model Context Protocol)']); });
